description:
Those ladies, the way they bad-mouth each other, you probably think that they don't get along.

But if that were true, they wouldn't stay out here together, would they?

title: Expert F (Battle Frontier · Lounge 7)
description:
Buhahaha!

You couldn't tell it from looking now, but I used to be one tough TRAINER.

I had a reputation as the toughest BEAUTY around, I tell you!

… … … … … …

What is it now? You don't believe me.

I'm not like that blowhard woman over there. I'm actually talented!

Let me prove it to you. I can teach your POKéMON special and yet cute moves.

But my lessons don't come free. How about paying fo

title: Expert F (Battle Frontier · Lounge 7)
description:
Ihihihi!

I know it's hard to see now, but I used to be one fantastic TRAINER.

I had a reputation as the most invincible SWIMMER around, I tell you!

… … … … … …

What's wrong? You don't believe me.

I'm not like that buffoonish woman over there. I'm actually experienced!

I can prove it to you. I can teach your POKéMON hard and yet pretty moves.

But my lessons don't come free. How about paying

title: Gentleman (Battle Frontier · Lounge 7)
description:
When I was just a wee YOUNGSTER, those ladies were strong and beautiful.

They were idols among us TRAINERS.

Even now, age hasn't dulled their abilities.

In fact, their POKéMON moves have grown even more polished.

But… For some reason, I can't help but feel this…

Time is so cruel…

title: Battle Frontier · Lounge 8
description: Indoor map; 3 object events.

title: Ninja Boy (Battle Frontier · Lounge 8)
description:
At the BATTLE TOWER, an older girl told me that I have a lot of talent for battling!

I like POKéMON CONTESTS more!

But I'm no good at CONTESTS!

I guess having talent and liking something aren't the same.

title: Man 3 (Battle Frontier · Lounge 8)
description:
What a TRAINER needs…

Knowledge… Strategy… Luck… Guts… Spirit… Bravery… And ability…

Well, I'm all set in every way! I'll be unstoppable at every building!

Huh? POKéMON? What's that?

title: Woman 5 (Battle Frontier · Lounge 8)
description:
Do you know about the FRONTIER BRAINS?

That's what SCOTT calls the seven special TRAINERS that run the seven facilities in the BATTLE FRONTIER.

Dear, what do you think of this? Wouldn't this make a nice gift?

It's…PRO…TE…IN? It sounds delicious, doesn't it?

title: Old Man (Battle Frontier · Mart)
description:
We came here to chaperon our grandson.

But since we're here, we thought we should get some souvenirs.

title: Boy 2 (Battle Frontier · Mart)
description:
A lot of the BATTLE FRONTIER's facilities don't allow the use of items during battles.

That rule makes things tougher than they already are!

title: Ninja Boy (Battle Frontier · Outside East)
description:
Wow! It's huge!

The BATTLE TOWER feels special. It's different from the others.

title: Man 3 (Battle Frontier · Outside East)
description:
My grand ambition is to conquer both the BATTLE FRONTIER and the POKéMON LEAGUE.

And if my dream comes true…

I… I'm going to ask MIMI next door if she will be friends with me!

title: Hiker (Battle Frontier · Outside East)
description:
The BATTLE PYRAMID's too harsh! I just can't make it to the top!

Since I'm out of options, maybe I can climb the outside…

title: Hex Maniac (Battle Frontier · Outside East)
description:
I thrive in darkness… Yes… What is worthy of me? None other than the BATTLE PYRAMID…

What say you to wandering in darkness and in utter and total desperation?

title: Black Belt (Battle Frontier · Outside East)
description:
I didn't sleep for a week, but then I put together the ultimate team!

I can't see myself losing, no joke. We're storming the BATTLE ARENA!

title: Cook (Battle Frontier · Outside East)
description:
ZIGG! I believe in you, little buddy!

I'll make my little ZIGG any favorite tasty treats you like if you win!

title: Expert F (Battle Frontier · Outside East)
description:
I may not look that impressive now, but I once beat a GYM LEADER.

Who knows, maybe I should give it another shot at glory.

title: Running Triathlete M (Battle Frontier · Outside East)
description:
Did SCOTT bring you here, too? What is it with that guy?

It sounds like he really does know how to spot talented TRAINERS, but…

I've never seen him battling in person ever.

title: Rich Boy (Battle Frontier · Outside East)
description:
People call me a busybody, but I can't help it.

Your hat's on crooked! Oh, no, trash on the ground! Oops, it's almost dinnertime!

I don't know if I can stand to just watch at the BATTLE PALACE…

title: Cycling Triathlete F (Battle Frontier · Outside East)
description:
I'm fast on my BIKE, and that goes for the way I battle, too.

I win matches in the blink of an eye!

title: Twin (Battle Frontier · Outside East)
description: I'm better than my daddy at POKéMON.

title: Man 1 (Battle Frontier · Outside East)
description:
Go on, my baby sweetie! Go rack up some wins for Daddy!

You're just like your mother, so you'll be dominating!

title: Zigzagoon 2 (Battle Frontier · Outside East)
description: ZIGZAGOON looks vacant…

title: Maniac (Battle Frontier · Outside East)
description:
It wasn't easy getting here, but I'd heard about this knockout pretty girl at the BATTLE ARENA.

Instead of her, do you know what I found?

A whole teeming mob of sweaty, stinky, and primitive martial artists!

title: Girl 3 (Battle Frontier · Outside East)
description:
I sometimes see this really important- looking old man going in there.

He has these really awesome POKéMON. He seems really nice, though.

title: Psychic M (Battle Frontier · Outside East)
description:
Do you know it? The legend of the BATTLE PYRAMID?

When there comes a confident TRAINER reaching for the golden pinnacle, there shall appear a man among men.

Don't know that legend? Well, of course not! I just made it up!

What's it supposed to mean? That, my friend, I can't say!

title: Man 3 (Battle Frontier · Outside East)
description:
Man! Oh man! I've never lost once before!

But I got wiped out with no saving grace at all!

And then I'm told I don't have any talent?! Man!

title: Woman 5 (Battle Frontier · Outside East)
description:
This guy ran into a horribly tough TRAINER while he was on the BATTLE TOWER challenge.

Now look at him…

You need to be cautious if you ever decide to go to the BATTLE TOWER.

title: Woman 5 (Battle Frontier · Outside East)
description:
Yes! I've finally got enough Battle Points!

I guess I'll trade for another giant plush DOLL!

title: Black Belt (Battle Frontier · Outside East)
description:
Oh, yeah, okay! So this is the RANKING HALL!

I'd like to go down in history as a super champ and have my name recorded here for posterity.

title: Maniac (Battle Frontier · Outside East)
description: With you by my side, I can do anything.

title: Woman 4 (Battle Frontier · Outside East)
description:
Ooh, darling, you are so wonderful!

Ooh, I just can't wait anymore!

Let's go to a MULTI BATTLE ROOM right this instant!

If we get together in the BATTLE SALON, the power of our love will overcome everyone we meet.

Why, before us, darling, everything will topple like dominoes!

title: Old Woman (Battle Frontier · Outside East)
description:
Excuse me, young one. Have you good eyesight?

There is an odd tree past here, and to my tired eyes it seems to wiggle.

title: Gentleman (Battle Frontier · Outside East)
description:
The BATTLE FRONTIER isn't exclusively for tough TRAINERS.

Many people with special abilities have been invited, it seems.

That man SCOTT…

He may have built this place to serve a bigger objective…

title: Camper (Battle Frontier · Outside East)
description:
I… I saw it!

There was a sticky sort of a POKéMON with a long tail up ahead!

It was hiding under a boulder, and it kept staring at me!

title: Battle Frontier · Outside West
description: Route map; connects right to battle frontier outside east; 24 object events.

title: Boy 2 (Battle Frontier · Outside West)
description: I'm the best out of all my friends. But here… I've been useless!

title: Beauty (Battle Frontier · Outside West)
description: Hello, are you here for the ferry? May I see your TICKET?

title: Expert M (Battle Frontier · Outside West)
description:
Ah, so this here is the BATTLE DOME? I won't let GENTLEMEN beat me!

But where is the entrance?

title: Man 3 (Battle Frontier · Outside West)
description:
It's not as if just anyone can come here, you know?

Only those TRAINERS who've been recognized as tough are brought here.

That's why many TRAINERS don't even know about the BATTLE FRONTIER.

title: Woman 5 (Battle Frontier · Outside West)
description:
I've finally arrived at the BATTLE FRONTIER!

I'm sure to grab attention with my looks and ability!

title: Fat Man (Battle Frontier · Outside West)
description:
Munch, munch…

It looks like this square's filled with tough people.

Munch, munch…

title: Gentleman (Battle Frontier · Outside West)
description:
Oh? You're off to challenge the BATTLE DOME?

I'll wish you the best of luck. Let us both win our way up and meet in challenges.

title: Maniac (Battle Frontier · Outside West)
description:
Hey, bro…

Are you sure we can make challenges even if we don't have any POKéMON?

title: Maniac (Battle Frontier · Outside West)
description:
Hey, bro…

Are you sure we can make challenges even if we don't have any POKéMON?

title: Man 5 (Battle Frontier · Outside West)
description:
There used to be nothing here not all that long ago.

But, now look at this place! Amazing! I'll bring my mother out to see this.

title: Girl 1 (Battle Frontier · Outside West)
description:
I'm scared of going into the BATTLE PIKE because of SEVIPER…

B-but I came all the way here, so I will try to conquer everything! …Shudder…

title: Woman 3 (Battle Frontier · Outside West)
description:
Let's play rock, paper, scissors! One, two, three!

… … … … … …

title: Camper (Battle Frontier · Outside West)
description:
That's the BATTLE FACTORY. You can rent strong POKéMON there.

But it makes me wonder. Who's raising those rental POKéMON?

title: Lass (Battle Frontier · Outside West)
description: Today, I'm going to keep battling, no matter what, until I get a Symbol.

title: Man 2 (Battle Frontier · Outside West)
description: The BATTLE FRONTIER… I've long dreamed about a place like it.

title: Fisherman (Battle Frontier · Outside West)
description:
I believe I'm the only person here who, for some unknown reason, would choose fishing over battling.

Huh? You can't catch anything here? That's disappointing…

title: Fisherman (Battle Frontier · Outside West)
description:
I wanted to take a challenge as soon as I arrived here.

But on the way, I got seasick… Urrrrp…

title: Fat Man (Battle Frontier · Outside West)
description:
Crunch, munch…

A while back, I met this older girl at the BATTLE PIKE.

She had these eyes that were scary in a real ornery way.

Crunch, munch…

She got all furious: “Will you quit eating!” Then she whaled on me.

It was a hair-raising kind of scary experience, sure enough.

Crunch, munch…

title: Woman 2 (Battle Frontier · Outside West)
description:
Huh? Will you listen to yourself? That's nothing!

Why, the last time I cheered for him, our eyes met and sparks flew!

title: Boy 1 (Battle Frontier · Outside West)
description:
Whaaaaaat?! Pfft!

That only happened because I happened to be sitting next to you!

The DOME ACE only looked our way because my cheering was so loud!

title: Old Man (Battle Frontier · Outside West)
description:
Oh, shush! Keep that racket down!

You fair-weather fans should stick to cheering for some GYM LEADER!

The DOME ACE is mine! The only idol for me!

title: Man 4 (Battle Frontier · Outside West)
description:
Those people squabbling over there…

It's hard to believe, but they once were TRAINERS, and good ones, too.

They used to be incredibly tough, and they were famous, too.

But they were obliterated by this certain TRAINER at a tournament.

They were so thoroughly whipped, they became smitten by the TRAINER.

Now they're just fans of the TRAINER. They go cheer for their idol at the BATTLE DOME every

title: Pokefan F (Battle Frontier · Outside West)
description:
I heard a rumor that someone saw a POKéMON with an unusually long tail somewhere in the BATTLE FRONTIER.

It must be adorable. I'm sure of it…

Oh, challenges can wait. I feel driven to find the delightful creature!

I never learned about it at TRAINER'S SCHOOL at least.

I wonder where you can catch POKéMON like that.

description:
No one believes me, but I saw this gigantic POKéMON in the sky.

It seemed to squirm as it flew toward ROUTE 131.

By the way… Sniff… Um… You, uh…smell singed.

Were you at a volcano or something?

title: Girl 1 (Fortree City)
description:
The ground absorbs rainwater, and trees grow by drinking that water…

Our FORTREE CITY exists because there's both water and soil.

title: Woman 5 (Fortree City)
description:
I want to go to the POKéMON GYM, but something's blocking the way.

After all the bother I went through training on ROUTE 120…

title: Boy 1 (Fortree City)
description:
Living on top of trees is okay.

But sometimes BUG POKéMON come in through windows. It can be really startling.

title: Old Man (Fortree City)

The CITY consists of homes built on trees.

Perhaps because of that lifestyle, everyone is healthy and lively.

Why, even myself--I feel as if I've grown thirty years younger.

title: Gameboy Kid (Fortree City)
description: There are POKéMON that evolve when you trade them! That's what I heard.

title: Kecleon (Fortree City)
description: Something unseeable is in the way.

Merchandise you buy here is sent to your own PC.

I'm buying a pretty desk and I'm putting my cute DOLLS on it.

title: Winona (Fortree City · Gym)
description:
I am WINONA. I am the LEADER of the FORTREE POKéMON GYM.

I have become one with BIRD POKéMON and have soared the skies…

However grueling the battle, we have triumphed with grace…

Witness the elegant choreography of BIRD POKéMON and I!

title: Man 5 (Fortree City · Gym)
description: Behold the elegant battle style of BIRD POKéMON!

title: Camper (Fortree City · Gym)
description:
There's no need for WINONA, our GYM LEADER, to deal with you!

I'm plenty good enough for you!

title: Picnicker (Fortree City · Gym)
description: WINONA taught me personally! You can't beat me easily!

title: Man 5 (Fortree City · Gym)
description:
The lovers of BIRD POKéMON aspire to join this GYM.

As a member of the FORTREE GYM, I'm not allowed to lose!

title: Man 2 (Fortree City · Gym)
description:
Yo, how's it going, CHAMPION- bound {PLAYER}?

FORTREE GYM LEADER WINONA is a master of FLYING-type POKéMON.

She's waiting at the back of this GYM, behind the rotating doors.

She's waiting for new challengers who are trying to take wing!

Okay, go for it!

title: Man 5 (Fortree City · Gym)
description:
When WINONA takes to battle, her face shines with beautiful determination…

I'm not letting you witness that lovely sight!

title: Man 5 (Fortree City · Gym)
description:
You'd better know that there are all sorts of FLYING-type POKéMON.

You do know that, right?

description:
Wrooooaaar! I need it! I have to get me a {STR_VAR_1}! I'll do anything for it!

…Uh… Did you hear that? My shout from the bottom of my heart?

Having heard that, you will trade your {STR_VAR_1} for my {STR_VAR_2}, won't you?

title: Expert F (Fortree City · House 1)

Trading POKéMON with others…

It's as if you're trading your own memories with other people.

I hold a coin in my hand.

Now, tell me, have I palmed it in the right hand? Or in the left?

title: Expert M (Fortree City · House 2)
description:
Humph! My wife relies on HIDDEN POWER to stay awake.

She should just take a nap like I do, and SLEEP TALK.

I can teach your POKéMON how to SLEEP TALK instead. Interested?

title: Fortree City · House 3

description:
While speaking about POKéDEXES, I remembered something.

I met this TRAINER, STEVEN, when I was searching for rare stones.

Hoo, boy, he had some amazing POKéMON with him.

They weren't just rare, they were trained to terrifying extremes!

He might even be stronger than the GYM LEADER in this town…

title: School Kid M (Fortree City · House 3)

What's that thing you have there?

… … … … … …

Oh, it's called a POKéDEX? It's really awesome!

I think it's the number one town for living together with POKéMON.

There's no need to make nature conform to the way we want to live.

This jagged bumpiness… It rocks my soul!

description: Town map; weather sunny; connects right to route 112; 9 object events.

title: Expert F (Lavaridge Town)
description:
Oh, you like hot springs, do you?

That's surprising for one as young as you.

title: Expert M (Lavaridge Town)
description:
We draw as much hot water as we need, and yet the hot springs never run dry.

Isn't it magical?

These hot springs appear near active volcanoes. Veins of water under the ground are heated by magma to well up as hot springs.

title: Old Man (Lavaridge Town)
description:
Being buried in this hot sand is… Sigh…

So warm and heavenly…

Eh? Gyaah! Ouch!

A POKéMON nipped my backside!

title: Twin (Lavaridge Town)
description:
I bathe in the hot springs every day.

I want to become a beautiful and strong GYM LEADER like FLANNERY.

title: Hot Springs Old Woman (Lavaridge Town)
description:
If people put POKéMON in hot springs, it might be seriously strange.

Why, it might be an electric bath, or a bubble bath, or even a lava bath…

title: Hot Springs Old Woman (Lavaridge Town)
description: They're claiming that these hot springs are good for calming nervous tension, relieving aching muscles, solving romantic problems, and attracting money…

title: Expert F (Lavaridge Town)
description:
I have here an EGG.

I'd hoped to hatch it by covering it in hot sand by the hot springs. But that doesn't seem to be enough…

I've heard it would be best if it were kept together with POKéMON and carried about.

You are a TRAINER, yes? And your POKéMON radiate vitality.

So, what say you? Will you take this EGG to hatch?

title: Lavaridge Town · Gym · 1F
description: Indoor map; weather fog horizontal; 6 object events.

title: Flannery (Lavaridge Town · Gym · 1F)
description:
Welcome… No, wait.

Puny TRAINER, how good to see you've made it here!

I have been entrusted with the… No, wait.

I am FLANNERY, and I'm the GYM LEADER here!

Uh… Dare not underestimate me, though I have been LEADER only a short time!

With skills inherited from my grand- father, I shall, uh…demonstrate the hot moves we have honed on this land!

title: Man 5 (Lavaridge Town · Gym · 1F)
description: Owowowowow! Yikes, it's hot!

title: Man 3 (Lavaridge Town · Gym · 1F)
description: Can your POKéMON withstand 392-degree heat?

title: Man 5 (Lavaridge Town · Gym · 1F)
description: I'm trying to relieve my stress. Don't come along and stress me out!

title: Girl 3 (Lavaridge Town · Gym · 1F)
description: Um… Okay, I'll battle with you.

title: Man 2 (Lavaridge Town · Gym · 1F)
description:
Hey, how's it going, CHAMPION- bound {PLAYER}?

LAVARIDGE's GYM LEADER FLANNERY uses FIRE-type POKéMON.

Her passion for POKéMON burns stronger and hotter than a volcano.

Don't get too close to her--you'll burn! Hose her down with water and then go for it!

title: Lavaridge Town · Gym · B1F
description: Indoor map; weather fog horizontal; 4 object events.

title: Man 5 (Lavaridge Town · Gym · B1F)
description: Come on, get with it! Let's go before my feelings cool!

title: Man 5 (Lavaridge Town · Gym · B1F)
description:
You must be getting tired by now. You'd like to rest in the hot sand, wouldn't you?

But you should know that maintaining your willpower is an important ability for all TRAINERS.

title: Man 5 (Lavaridge Town · Gym · B1F)
description: See how the flames blaze wildly? They flare in anticipation of my win!

title: Hiker (Lavaridge Town · Gym · B1F)
description: As much as I love mountains, I especially love volcanoes.

You've come to look at herbal medicine in LAVARIDGE?

That's rather commendable.

I like you! Take this!

title: Expert M (Lavaridge Town · Herb Shop)
description: Herbal medicine works impressively well. But your POKéMON will dislike you for it. It must be horribly bitter!

title: Lavaridge Town · House

title: Old Man (Lavaridge Town · House)
description:
My wife's warming an EGG in the hot springs. This is what she told me.

She left two POKéMON with the DAY CARE. And they discovered that EGG!

title: Zigzagoon 2 (Lavaridge Town · House)
description: ZIGZAGOON: Pshoo!

title: Ninja Boy (Lavaridge Town · House)
description:
Ah, young one!

I am also a young one, but I mimic the styles and speech of the elderly folks of this town.

What do you say, young one? Would you agree to it if I were to offer to teach the move MIMIC?

title: Expert M (Lavaridge Town · Mart)

Use X SPEED to add to a POKéMON's SPEED in battle.

That will help it get in the first strike--a decided advantage!

title: Old Woman (Lavaridge Town · Mart)
description:
On MT. CHIMNEY's peak, there's a local specialty that you can buy only there.

Give it to a POKéMON--it will be elated.

title: Youngster (Lavaridge Town · Pokemon Center · 1F)
description:
It's sort of magical how just sitting in a hot-spring pool can invigorate.

I wish I could let my POKéMON soak, too.

title: Woman 3 (Lavaridge Town · Pokemon Center · 1F)
description:
I think POKéMON get closer to their TRAINERS if they spend time together.

The longer the better. That's what I think.

title: Gentleman (Lavaridge Town · Pokemon Center · 1F)

Hohoho! Hey, kid, you can reach the hot springs from here.

If POKéMON are getting rest, so too should their TRAINERS.

description: City map; weather sunny; connects left to route 121, right to route 124; 22 object events.

title: Sailor (Lilycove City)
description:
TEAM AQUA's been training their WAILMER in the cove.

We SAILORS can't get our boats out to sea with them in the way!

title: Girl 1 (Lilycove City)
description: Have you seen that strange cave in the cove at the edge of town?

title: Man 1 (Lilycove City)
description:
There's a POKéMON CONTEST HALL right in this here town.

That means well-raised POKéMON will come from all over the country.

My heart swells with excitement!

title: Rich Boy (Lilycove City)
description:
I came from KANTO.

The HOENN region is beautiful with all its water and verdant nature.

Hunh? Wait a second…

Could there be rare POKéMON that live only in this area?

title: Man 2 (Lilycove City)
description:
I'm an ART DEALER.

I am a buyer and seller of fine art, especially paintings.

I've heard that the MUSEUM here has magnificent works on exhibit…

title: Woman 2 (Lilycove City)
description:
I was taking a relaxing snooze at the seaside inn to the sound of waves…

When someone stole my POKéMON!

Who's the abductor? TEAM AQUA? Is it TEAM AQUA?

title: Expert M (Lilycove City)
description:
Even as we grow old and wrinkled, the sea remains forever young with the vivid brilliance of life…

Fwohoho fwohohohoho…

title: Expert F (Lilycove City)
description:
It was sixty years ago that my husband proposed to me here. The sea remains as beautiful as ever.

Mufufufu mufufufufufu…

title: Expert M (Lilycove City)
description:
Hm, you know of the peculiar cavern in this cove?

That had been a natural formation, but then that TEAM AQUA lot came along and made their renovations.

They call themselves the “nature-loving TEAM AQUA”!

But what they do and what they say don't match at all!

title: Aqua Member M (Lilycove City)
description: There! WAILMER! Leap out of the water now!

title: Aqua Member M (Lilycove City)
description: If this whole wide world becomes ours, TEAM AQUA's, it will be a happier place for POKéMON, too.

title: Aqua Member M (Lilycove City)
description:
Fufufu…

We moved more loot into our secret HIDEOUT today…

Wh-who are you?! I was just talking to myself!

title: Aqua Member M (Lilycove City)
description:
I'm just a GRUNT, so I don't know what the BOSS is thinking…

But being on TEAM AQUA, I know I'll get the chance to do big things!

Wh-who are you?! I was just talking to myself!

title: Aqua Member M (Lilycove City)
description:
Hey, you!

Don't go near the cave in the cove!

Why? You don't need a reason why! I'm an adult, so you just listen to me!

title: Gentleman (Lilycove City)
description:
When it gets right down to it…

The same way suits suit me perfectly, a crisp breeze suits the sea.

And you, a BERRY suits you to a “T”…

Why should that be so?

title: Var 0 (Lilycove City)
description: MAY: The POKéMON I raised won't be beaten by your POKéMON, {PLAYER}{KUN}!

title: School Kid M (Lilycove City)
description: Do you know about the machine BERRY BLENDER?

title: Woman 3 (Lilycove City)
description:
On our honeymoon, we vowed to see as many rare POKéMON as we can.

So we were delighted to see a rare POKéMON as soon as we arrived.

I mean, we are totally happy!

title: Man 2 (Lilycove City)
description:
We just arrived here on our honeymoon vacation.

We happened to see a DRAGON-type POKéMON flying way up in the sky.

Do cool POKéMON like that live in the HOENN region?

title: Sailor (Lilycove City)
description:
I heard there's a tower somewhere out on the sea routes.

It's called the SKY PILLAR, I hear.

title: Fat Man (Lilycove City)
description:
I saw this tall tower somewhere around ROUTE 131.

Could that possibly be…?

title: Lilycove City · Contest Hall
description: Indoor map; 32 object events.

title: Boy 1 (Lilycove City · Contest Hall)
description:
This POKéMON won the BEAUTY CONTEST here before.

Well, guess what? Today, I made it win a SMARTNESS CONTEST!

My abilities scare even me…

title: Boy 3 (Lilycove City · Contest Hall)
description:
I've entered a bunch of CONTESTS, so I'm seeing how things work.

If you're in a COOLNESS CONTEST, cool moves go over as appeals.

But smart moves and cute moves don't go over well, for instance.

title: Girl 3 (Lilycove City · Contest Hall)
description:
That young man who won earlier had a whole bunch of different {POKEBLOCK}S.

Can you win if you had that many of those things?

I wish I would be on TV sometime.

title: Pokefan M (Mauville City)
description: UNCLE: It's because of POKéMON that this boy's got more pep, I suppose… But he's become a bit too peppy…

WATTSON: Oh, {PLAYER}{KUN}! You look like you have a lot of zip! That's a good thing, wahahahaha!

Fine! I've decided! I need a favor, {PLAYER}{KUN}!

MAUVILLE CITY has an underground sector called NEW MAUVILLE.

Wahahahah! Now, that is amusing!

description: Hi, I'm the BARD. Would you like to hear my song?

title: Woman 1 (Mauville City · Pokemon Center · 1F)

That man over there, he says weird things!

title: Woman 5 (Mauville City · Pokemon Center · 1F)

Which room would you like to enter?

They put up your record on the wall for everyone to see.

It's embarrassing if you lose more often than you win…

I… I'm COZMO… I'm a PROFESSOR…

TEAM MAGMA asked me to guide them to METEOR FALLS…

But they tricked me. They even took my METEORITE away…

And then another similar bunch, TEAM AQUA showed up.

After that… I don't understand any of it.

What are they going to do with that METEORITE at MT. CHIMNEY?

We battled alongside each other at the SOOTOPOLIS SPACE CENTER.

title: Sailor (Mossdeep City)
description:
I heard from a SAILOR buddy that TEAM AQUA set up shop in LILYCOVE.

I also heard that someone came along and wiped the floor with them!

But MOSSDEEP here's been targeted by that TEAM MAGMA.

If you want to know what they're up to, go visit the SPACE CENTER.

title: Expert M (Mossdeep City)
description:
All life needs the sea to live, even though it makes its home on the land.

Life, having run its course, becomes soil and returns to the land.

And the sea is always connected to the land.

Yes, like the very shoreline here.

title: Pokefan F (Mossdeep City)
description:
The island's SPACE CENTER has been launching huge rockets.

There's been some kind of an uproar over a letter they received recently.

title: Ninja Boy (Mossdeep City)
description:
Around MOSSDEEP, you can see wild WAILMER.

It's called, uh… What was it now…

WAI, WAI, WAI…

WAILMER watching!

title: Girl 1 (Mossdeep City)
description:
Wouldn't it be nice?

If the whole world was covered in plants and flowers like this island?

title: Man 1 (Mossdeep City)
description:
A voyage on a ship is fine.

But crossing the sea with POKéMON using SURF…

Now that's an exhilarating trip! Wouldn't you agree, youngster?

title: Woman 1 (Mossdeep City)
description:
This rock has a special meaning to the people at the SPACE CENTER.

They put it here as their wish for their rockets to fly safely.

When you make a wish, what do you use? Do you wish upon a star?

I use a wish tag to make it happen. That's what I do.

title: Boy 2 (Mossdeep City)
description:
I got this from STEVEN, but I don't know what it's good for.

I think it's called KING'S ROCK. Do you want it?

title: Black Belt (Mossdeep City)
description:
I can't do this anymore!

It's utterly hopeless!

I'm a FIGHTING-type TRAINER, so I can't win at the MOSSDEEP GYM no matter how hard I try!

Argh! Punch! Punch! Punch! Punch! Punch! Punch!

What, don't look at me that way! I'm only hitting the ground!

Or do you want me to teach your POKéMON DYNAMICPUNCH?

title: Scott (Mossdeep City)
description:
SCOTT: {PLAYER}{KUN}, feeling good? I'm doing great!

I'd heard MOSSDEEP's GYM LEADER is pretty strong, so I decided to come take a look-see for myself.

But there's something wrong about this town.

People are going on about a warning letter and the SPACE CENTER…

I don't think it concerns me in any way, though.

title: Black Belt (Mossdeep City)
description:
Ahh… It feels great letting the waves wash over my feet…

Speaking of the waves, you know that island city SOOTOPOLIS?

I think the GYM there had a new LEADER come in.

People tell me the new LEADER once mentored WALLACE.

Wrooooooooaaaar! … … … … … … …

Sometimes, I'm out of sync…

title: Lass (Mossdeep City · Gym)
description:
The roads you have traveled… What you have experienced…

Come at me with everything you've learned!

title: Lass (Mossdeep City · Gym)
description:
I see it… I see your future…

If you can beat me, I will tell you your future!

title: Psychic M (Mossdeep City · Gym)
description: Let me see your talent!

title: Lass (Mossdeep City · Gym)
description:

Yo, how's it going, CHAMPION-bound {PLAYER}?

The GYM LEADERS here use PSYCHIC-type POKéMON.

If you go up against them with FIGHTING- or POISON-type POKéMON, they'll inflict horrible damage!

Plus, they'll come at you with outstanding combination attacks.

If you want to win, you'll need to show them how tight you are with your POKéMON. Go for it!

title: Liza (Mossdeep City · Gym)
description:
TATE: Hehehe… Were you surprised?

LIZA: Fufufu… Were you surprised?

What a surprise! I didn't expect to see a TRAINER out in the sea.

I think we should battle!

title: Swimmer F (Route 130)
description: In the deep blue sea, my shattered blue heart finds comfort among waves.

title: Swimmer M (Route 130)
description: Floating on the open sea like this… It's peaceful.

title: Route 131
description: Ocean route map; weather sunny; connects left to pacifidlog town, right to route 130; 8 object events.

title: Swimmer M (Route 131)
description: The sea is teeming with POKéMON. It's not easy swimming, I tell you.

title: Swimmer M (Route 131)
description: The sea… The sea… The sea… The sea as far as these eyes can see! I'm sick and tired of the sea!

title: Swimmer F (Route 131)
description: Hi, sweetie, wait! We should battle, you and I!

title: Swimmer F (Route 131)
description:
Why do men love bathing suits so much?

They all ogle me!

title: Swimmer F (Route 131)
description: RELI: We'll work together as siblings to take you on!

title: Tuber M Swimming (Route 131)
description: IAN: I'm doing my best together with my sis!

title: Swimmer M (Route 131)
description:
The people of PACIFIDLOG are a peaceful bunch.

They never get angry. That goes for me, too.

title: Swimmer F (Route 131)
description: If you can beat me, I'll give you some great information!

title: Route 132
description: Ocean route map; weather sunny; connects left to route 133, right to pacifidlog town; 10 object events.

title: Swimmer M (Route 132)
description: I used to catch colds all the time as a kid, but I became totally fit after I started swimming.

title: Swimmer F (Route 132)
description: I try not to swim where the currents are too strong.

title: Black Belt (Route 132)
description: I contemplate POKéMON 24 hours a day. How could you possibly beat me?

title: Fisherman (Route 132)
description: Win or lose, you'll never know until you try!

title: Expert M (Route 132)
description: Now where could my wife have gone? I'm always with her. I wonder if I can win on my own.

title: Woman 5 (Route 132)
description: I liked training here by myself. It's awful that all these people came!

title: Expert F (Route 132)
description: I'm always with my husband, but I can win even without him.

title: Man 3 (Route 132)
description: Someone's been watching me intently. Was it you?

title: Route 133
description: Ocean route map; weather sunny; connects left to route 134, right to route 132; 10 object events.

title: Swimmer M (Route 133)
description: Did the currents carry you here, too? This must have been fated. Let's battle!

title: Swimmer F (Route 133)
description: Welcome! I've been expecting you!

title: Swimmer F (Route 133)
description: I've led a life of woe and misery… I've been cast away, and this is where I've drifted…

title: Man 5 (Route 133)
description: I came all the way out here with my BIRD POKéMON.

title: Man 3 (Route 133)
description: I want to win like everyone else, but I won't raise POKéMON like everyone else.

title: Expert F (Route 133)
description: I must have battled thousands of times. I've lost count.

title: Expert M (Route 133)
description: Young people are too happy to go with the flow. They're without direction.

description: Even those POKéMON that can swim are carried along by the rapid currents.

title: Swimmer F (Route 134)
description: My LUVDISC are looking for a fun match. Will you join us?

title: Man 3 (Route 134)
description: The savage tide in this area serves to make us stronger than ever.

title: Man 5 (Route 134)
description: Okeydokey! That's enough rest, gang! It's time for a match!

title: Black Belt (Route 134)
description: You're a POKéMON TRAINER. No need for words. We battle now.

title: Woman 5 (Route 134)
description: Can your POKéMON dodge our lightning-quick attacks?

title: Sailor (Route 134)
description: O-our boat! The tide carried it away!

title: Girl 3 (Route 134)
description: My POKéMON can't be taken down easily!

title: Sailor (Route 134)
description: Listen, have you seen another SAILOR around here?

title: Rustboro City
description: City map; weather sunny; connects up to route 115, down to route 104, right to route 116; 16 object events.

title: Woman 5 (Rustboro City)
description:
I challenged the GYM LEADER, but…

It's not going to be easy winning with my FIRE-type POKéMON…

FIRE-type POKéMON don't match up well against ROCK-type POKéMON…

title: Fat Man (Rustboro City)
description:
The DEVON CORPORATION… We all just shorten it to DEVON.

That company makes all sorts of convenient products.

title: Ninja Boy (Rustboro City)
description:
POKéMON TRAINER'S SCHOOL!

If I go to this school, will I be able to catch rare POKéMON easily?

title: Twin (Rustboro City)
description:
Wow, you have POKéMON with you, too.

When I get bigger, I'm going to go places with POKéMON, too.

title: Boy 2 (Rustboro City)
description:
The old sailor MR. BRINEY lives in a cottage by the sea.

He goes for walks in the tunnel every so often.

title: Man 3 (Rustboro City)
description:
Have you taken the POKéMON GYM challenge?

When you get that shiny GYM BADGE in hand, I guess TRAINERS begin to realize what is required of them.

title: Little Boy (Rustboro City)
description: If a POKéMON gains experience in battles, it can sometimes change in the way it looks.

title: Little Girl (Rustboro City)
description: A POKéMON changes shape? If one did that, I would be shocked!

title: Man 2 (Rustboro City)
description: That shady character, I think he took off towards the tunnel over there.

title: Devon Employee (Rustboro City)
description:
Oh? Who might you be? You're a new face around these parts.

Have you just transferred into the POKéMON TRAINER'S SCHOOL?

title: Man 4 (Rustboro City)
description:
A POKéMON you get in a trade from someone grows fast.

But if you don't have certain GYM BADGES, it may not obey you…

title: Var 0 (Rustboro City)
description:
MAY: Oh, hi, {PLAYER}{KUN}!

You had a MATCH CALL feature put on your POKéNAV!

Let's register each other so we can contact one another anytime!

… … … … … …

title: Boy 1 (Rustboro City)
description:
Did you know this?

You can have a 2-on-2 battle even if you're not with another TRAINER.

If you catch the eyes of two TRAINERS when you have two or more POKéMON, they'll both challenge you.

Don't you think it'd be cool if you could beat two TRAINERS by yourself?

title: Rustboro City · Cutters House
description: Indoor map; 2 object events.

title: Pokefan M (Rustboro City · Cutters House)
description:
That determined expression… That limber way you move… And your well-trained POKéMON…

You're obviously a skilled TRAINER!

No, wait, don't say a word. I can tell just by looking at you.

I'm sure that you can put this HIDDEN MACHINE to good use.

No need to be modest or shy. Go on, take it!

title: Lass (Rustboro City · Cutters House)
description:
When they were expanding the city of RUSTBORO, my dad helped out.

He made his POKéMON use CUT to clear the land of trees.

title: Rustboro City · Devon Corp · 1F
description: Indoor map; 3 object events.

title: Devon Employee (Rustboro City · Devon Corp · 1F)
description:
Hey, those RUNNING SHOES! They're one of our products!

It makes me happy when I see someone using something we made.

title: Devon Employee (Rustboro City · Devon Corp · 1F)
description: I'm sorry, only authorized people are allowed to enter here.

title: Woman 3 (Rustboro City · Devon Corp · 1F)
description:
Hello and welcome to the DEVON CORPORATION.

We're proud producers of items and medicine that enhance your life.

title: Rustboro City · Devon Corp · 2F
description: Indoor map; 6 object events.

title: Scientist 1 (Rustboro City · Devon Corp · 2F)
description:
We're developing a device for talking with POKéMON.

But we haven't had much success…

title: Scientist 1 (Rustboro City · Devon Corp · 2F)
description:
I'm developing new kinds of POKé BALLS…

But I haven't made much headway…

title: Scientist 1 (Rustboro City · Devon Corp · 2F)
description:
I made the POKéNAV!

As an engineer, I feel blessed to have made something so great!

title: Scientist 1 (Rustboro City · Devon Corp · 2F)
description:
I'm trying to develop a device that visually reproduces the dreams of POKéMON…

But it's not going well.

title: Scientist 1 (Rustboro City · Devon Corp · 2F)
description:
I've been trying to develop a device that resurrects POKéMON from fossils…

And, it's working!

title: Scientist 1 (Rustboro City · Devon Corp · 2F)
description:
I'm trying to develop a new feature for the POKéNAV…

But it's not going well.

description: Every POKéMON has a special ability that it can use.

title: Woman 5 (Rustboro City · Flat 1 · 1F)
description: POKéMON are such strange creatures.

title: Pokefan F (Rustboro City · Flat 1 · 2F)
description:
Oh, it's so hard every day…

What's hard? You need to ask?

It's trying to figure out what to make for meals every day.

It really isn't easy coming up with meals every day.

title: Skitty Doll (Rustboro City · Flat 1 · 2F)
description: It's a POKéMON plush DOLL!

title: Treecko Doll (Rustboro City · Flat 1 · 2F)
description: It's a POKéMON plush DOLL!

title: Torchic Doll (Rustboro City · Flat 1 · 2F)
description: It's a POKéMON plush DOLL!

title: Man 1 (Rustboro City · Flat 1 · 2F)
description:
Oh, hello! Welcome to the PEPPER household.

I have a question for you. Have you ever baby-sat?

You see, I'm a new father, so raising a child is all new to me.

And I have a problem. My daughter WALDA doesn't laugh enough.

I think she'd laugh for me if I told her something funny.

Do you know of a funny word or phrase you can tell me?

title: Mudkip Doll (Rustboro City · Flat 1 · 2F)
description: It's a POKéMON plush DOLL!

title: Pikachu Doll (Rustboro City · Flat 1 · 2F)
description: It's a POKéMON plush DOLL!

description: Indoor map; 2 object events.

title: Skitty (Rustboro City · Flat 2 · 1F)
description: SKITTY: Gyaaaah!

title: Old Woman (Rustboro City · Flat 2 · 1F)
description: DEVON CORPORATION's workers live in this building.

title: Rustboro City · Flat 2 · 2F
description: Indoor map; 2 object events.

title: Old Man (Rustboro City · Flat 2 · 2F)
description: Way back in the old days, DEVON was just a teeny, tiny company.

title: Ninja Boy (Rustboro City · Flat 2 · 2F)
description:
My daddy's working at the CORPORATION.

My daddy made this! But I can't use it, so you can have it.

title: Rustboro City · Flat 2 · 3F
description: Indoor map; 2 object events.

title: Devon Employee (Rustboro City · Flat 2 · 3F)
description: DEVON's PRESIDENT likes to collect rare stones.

title: Woman 1 (Rustboro City · Flat 2 · 3F)
description: I think the PRESIDENT's son also collects rare stones.

title: Rustboro City · Gym
description: Indoor map; 5 object events.

title: Roxanne (Rustboro City · Gym)
description:
Hello, I am ROXANNE, the RUSTBORO POKéMON GYM LEADER.

I became a GYM LEADER so that I might apply what I learned at the POKéMON TRAINER'S SCHOOL in battle.

Would you kindly demonstrate how you battle, and with which POKéMON?

title: Youngster (Rustboro City · Gym)
description: Don't take us GYM TRAINERS lightly! I'll show you why we're better!

title: Youngster (Rustboro City · Gym)
description: If you can't beat me, you won't stand a chance against ROXANNE!

title: Man 2 (Rustboro City · Gym)
description:
Yo, how's it going?

Listen, my friend! Would you like to become the CHAMPION?

I'm no TRAINER, not me, but I can sure give you winning advice.

That's settled, then! We'll aim for the POKéMON CHAMPIONSHIP together!

It's your job as a TRAINER to collect GYM BADGES, am I right?

But GYM LEADERS aren't pushovers!

And that's where I come in! I'm here to provide expert advice!

ROXANNE, the GYM LEAD

title: Hiker (Rustboro City · Gym)
description:
We might be in the middle of town, but so what?

My ROCK POKéMON need room to rampage!

title: Rustboro City · House 1
description: Indoor map; 2 object events.

title: Camper (Rustboro City · House 1)
description:
Huh? My POKéMON is cute? Sure, I knew that.

But if you really want, I'm willing to trade it to you.

I'll trade you my {STR_VAR_2} for a {STR_VAR_1} if you want.

title: Hiker (Rustboro City · House 1)
description:
In all sorts of places, there are all sorts of POKéMON and people.

I find that fascinating, so I go to all sorts of places.

title: Rustboro City · House 2
description: Indoor map; 2 object events.

title: Pokefan F (Rustboro City · House 2)
description:
The TRAINER'S SCHOOL is excellent.

If you study there, you could even become a GYM LEADER.

title: Little Girl (Rustboro City · House 2)
description:
ROXANNE, the GYM LEADER, really knows a lot about POKéMON.

She's really strong, too!

title: Rustboro City · House 3
description: Indoor map; 3 object events.

title: Old Man (Rustboro City · House 3)
description:
For my own POKéMON, I give them perfectly suited nicknames!

It's my expression of, uh… originality, yes, that's it!

title: Old Woman (Rustboro City · House 3)
description:
But giving the name PEKACHU to a PIKACHU? It seems pointless.

I suppose it is good to use a name that's easy to understand, but…

title: Pikachu (Rustboro City · House 3)
description: PEKACHU: Peka!

title: Rustboro City · Mart
description: Indoor map; 4 object events.

title: Mart Employee (Rustboro City · Mart)
description:
Welcome!

How may I serve you?

title: Boy 1 (Rustboro City · Mart)
description:
My POKéMON evolved. It has a lot of HP now.

I should buy SUPER POTIONS for it instead of ordinary POTIONS.

title: Pokefan F (Rustboro City · Mart)
description:
I'm buying some PARLYZ HEALS and ANTIDOTES.

Just in case I run into SHROOMISH in PETALBURG WOODS.

title: Bug Catcher (Rustboro City · Mart)
description:
I'm getting an ESCAPE ROPE just in case I get lost in a cave.

I just need to use it to get back to the entrance.

description: Indoor map; 4 object events.

title: Nurse (Rustboro City · Pokemon Center · 1F)
description:
Hello, and welcome to the POKéMON CENTER.

We restore your tired POKéMON to full health.

Would you like to rest your POKéMON?

title: Man 1 (Rustboro City · Pokemon Center · 1F)
description:
My POKéMON has a NAIVE nature, and my friend's has a JOLLY nature.

It's fascinating how POKéMON have personalities!

title: Boy 1 (Rustboro City · Pokemon Center · 1F)
description:
Just like people, there are male and female POKéMON.

But no one seems to have any idea how they're different.

title: Girl 3 (Rustboro City · Pokemon Center · 1F)
description:
The man next door gave me an HM!

I used it to teach my POKéMON how to CUT down skinny trees.

title: Rustboro City · Pokemon Center · 2F
description: Indoor map; 4 object events.

title: Teala (Rustboro City · Pokemon Center · 2F)
description:
Welcome to the POKéMON WIRELESS CLUB UNION ROOM.

You may interact directly with other TRAINERS here, some of whom you may not even know.

Would you like to enter the ROOM?

title: Teala (Rustboro City · Pokemon Center · 2F)
description:
Hello, {PLAYER}!

It's me, TEALA, the POKéMON CENTER 2F attendant.

Is there something you needed to ask me about linking?

title: Teala (Rustboro City · Pokemon Center · 2F)
description:
Welcome to the POKéMON WIRELESS CLUB DIRECT CORNER.

You may interact directly with your friends here.

Which room would you like to enter?

title: Mystery Gift Man (Rustboro City · Pokemon Center · 2F)
description:
Thank you for using the MYSTERY EVENT System.

You must be {PLAYER}. There is a ticket here for you.

title: Gameboy Kid (Rustboro City · Pokemon School)
description: I'm trading POKéMON with my friend right now.

title: Gameboy Kid (Rustboro City · Pokemon School)
description: I always wanted a SEEDOT, and I'm finally getting one!

title: Rich Boy (Rustboro City · Pokemon School)
description: POKéMON can hold items, but they don't know what to do with man-made items like POTION and ANTIDOTE.

title: Lass (Rustboro City · Pokemon School)
description:
You know how some POKéMON moves can confuse a POKéMON?

A confused POKéMON will sometimes attack itself without meaning to.

But once it leaves battle, it will return to normal.

title: School Kid M (Rustboro City · Pokemon School)
description:
A POKéMON holding a BERRY will heal itself…

There are many kinds of items that POKéMON can hold…

Boy, it sure is hard taking notes down…

title: Gentleman (Rustboro City · Pokemon School)
description:
Students who don't study get a little taste of my QUICK CLAW.

Whether or not you are a good student will be evident from the way you use this item.

title: Scott (Rustboro City · Pokemon School)
description:
Hello? Didn't we meet before? I think back in PETALBURG CITY.

Let me introduce myself. My name's SCOTT.

I've been traveling everywhere in search of outstanding TRAINERS.

More specifically, I'm looking for POKéMON battle experts.

So, what brings you to this SCHOOL? Are you a TRAINER, too?

The first thing you should do is to have a POKéMON learn the move CUT.

If I remember correctly, someone i

title: Rusturf Tunnel
description: Underground map; weather fog horizontal; 10 object events.

title: Black Belt (Rusturf Tunnel)
description:
… …

Why can't they keep digging? Is the bedrock too hard?

My beloved awaits me in VERDANTURF TOWN just beyond here…

If RUSTBORO and VERDANTURF were joined by this tunnel, I could visit her every day…

But this… What am I to do?

title: Breakable Rock (Rusturf Tunnel)
description: This rock appears to be breakable. Would you like to use ROCK SMASH?

title: Aqua Member M (Rusturf Tunnel)
description:
Grah, keelhaul it all!

That hostage POKéMON turned out to be worthless!

And to think I made a getaway… In this tunnel to nowhere!

Hey! You! So you want to battle me?

title: Wingull (Rusturf Tunnel)
description: PEEKO: Pii pihyoh!

title: Breakable Rock (Rusturf Tunnel)
description: This rock appears to be breakable. Would you like to use ROCK SMASH?

title: Hiker (Rusturf Tunnel)
description:
What do you call a wild man up in the mountains? A mountain man, right?

So why don't they call a POKéMON in the mountains a mountain POKéMON?

title: Woman 2 (Rusturf Tunnel)
description:
On the other side of this rock… My boyfriend is there.

He… He's not just digging the tunnel to come see me.

He works his hands raw and rough for the benefit of everyone.

title: SS Tidal Corridor
description: Indoor map; 5 object events.

title: Sailor (SS Tidal Corridor)
description:
It'll be some time before we make land, I reckon.

You can rest up in your cabin if you'd like. Your cabin's No. 2.

The bed in there is soft and plushy. I can attest to how comfy it is!

title: Sailor (SS Tidal Corridor)
description: Go visit other cabins. TRAINERS bored of the boat trip will be itching to battle.

title: Expert M (SS Tidal Corridor)
description:
MR. BRINEY: Welcome aboard, {PLAYER}{KUN}!

They made me honorary captain of the S.S. TIDAL!

You can call me CAPTAIN BRINEY now!

You know, I retired once before, but when I saw this majestic ship…

Let me just say, it stirred my sleeping soul as a sailor!

title: Wingull (SS Tidal Corridor)
description: PEEKO: Pihyo pihyohyo…

title: SS Tidal Lower Deck
description: Indoor map; 2 object events.

title: Sailor (SS Tidal Lower Deck)
description:
Arrrgh! I'm fed up and dog-tired of cleaning this huge place!

Let's have a quick battle!

title: Sailor (SS Tidal Lower Deck)
description: This is the bottom of the ship's hull. There's plenty of room. It'll be alright for a POKéMON battle.

description: Child… Did you knock on the door?

title: Man 4 (SS Tidal Rooms)

title: Woman 4 (SS Tidal Rooms)
description: LEA: I feel a little silly, but… We'll show you our lovey-dovey power!

title: Rich Boy (SS Tidal Rooms)
description:
Ah, you've come just in time.

I'm bored, you see. You may entertain me.

title: Woman 2 (SS Tidal Rooms)
description: Oh, you're such an adorable TRAINER. Would you like to have tea? Or would you rather battle?

title: Maniac (SS Tidal Rooms)
description:
Uh… Hi! I… I'm not acting suspicious! Uh… You can have this! For free!

It… Honestly, I didn't SNATCH it from someone! I'd never do such a thing! It's clean! You can use it!

title: Youngster (Safari Zone · Rest House)
description:
I don't have any {POKEBLOCK}S, but I caught a good number of POKéMON.

You can improve your chances of making a catch by getting closer to them before throwing a SAFARI BALL.

title: Psychic M (Safari Zone · Rest House)
description:
If you use {POKEBLOCK}S, wild POKéMON won't be so quick to run away.

It's not much use to give {POKEBLOCK}S to POKéMON that don't flee easily.

description:
If you put a {POKEBLOCK} on the FEEDER, POKéMON are attracted to it.

I think POKéMON with the same sort of nature are drawn by a certain {POKEBLOCK}.

description: You still have time left. Would you like to exit the SAFARI ZONE now?

description:
Did you know?

If you put a {POKEBLOCK} in that square box, POKéMON gather around.

I want to keep going deeper, but I forgot to bring a BIKE.

Something tells me that rare POKéMON live in the outlying areas.

I put a {POKEBLOCK} on the {POKEBLOCK} FEEDER. But it seems to have disappeared.

I guess POKéMON must have eaten it without me noticing.

description: City map; weather sunny; connects up to route 110, down to route 109, right to route 134; 35 object events.

title: Fat Man (Slateport City)
description:
Whew… I'm just bushed…

I hiked over from MAUVILLE CITY. But, boy, this city's huge.

If I'd known this, I would've ridden my BIKE here.

title: Man 1 (Slateport City)
description:
STERN, the fellow who built the MUSEUM, also happens to be the leader of an undersea exploration team.

So, everyone calls him CAPT. STERN.

title: Rich Boy (Slateport City)
description:
Wroooar! I'm going to compete in the BATTLE TENT, too!

But before that, I need to catch some POKéMON!

title: Woman 4 (Slateport City)
description: What is that over there? That long line…

title: Aqua Member F (Slateport City)
description: Hey, there! Quit pushing! This is the line, can't you see?

title: Cook (Slateport City)
description:
Ooh, look at this!

The seaweed you can get around these parts is fresh and full of life.

Why, it looks like it can even rear up and attack!

title: Old Woman (Slateport City)
description:
Where the water is clean, the fruits of bountiful harvest gather.

And where people gather, a market soon starts.

That is how a town is born and grows.

title: Girl 1 (Slateport City)
description:
Shopping where you can breathe the scent of the ocean…

SLATEPORT is such a wonderful place!

title: Cameraman (Slateport City)
description: TY: Okay, CAPT. STERN, a big smile for the camera!

title: Reporter F (Slateport City)
description: GABBY: I see, I see. You've had a most invaluable experience…

title: Scientist 1 (Slateport City)
description: CAPT. STERN: Yes, indeed. We intend to move ahead with our exploration.

title: Sailor (Slateport City)
description:
The sea is just so vast…

Could the sea have been made by the tears shed by POKéMON?

title: Sailor (Slateport City)
description:
Do you know what they do with old ships that become too creaky to sail?

They sink them in the sea so they become habitats for POKéMON.

title: Pokefan F (Slateport City)
description: Whenever I visit here, I get carried away and buy too much.

title: Man 3 (Slateport City)
description:
Recently, a BATTLE TENT was built in SLATEPORT.

GYMS are fun, but the BATTLE TENT's awesome in its own way.

You should go find tough POKéMON for the BATTLE TENT!

title: Maniac (Slateport City)
description: If you want to change your POKéMON's nickname, you'll have to get the NAME RATER to help you.

title: Woman 5 (Slateport City)
description:
Any POKéMON you get in a trade, you can't change its nickname.

The original TRAINER's love for that POKéMON is in the nickname.

title: Aqua Member M (Slateport City)
description: TEAM AQUA has a policy of assembling and dispersing at the operation site.

title: Aqua Member M (Slateport City)
description:
Our BOSS is brilliant.

What would he want to do with a MUSEUM now?

title: Mart Employee (Slateport City)
description:
Welcome!

How may I serve you?

title: Mart Employee (Slateport City)
description:
Welcome!

How may I serve you?

title: Man 5 (Slateport City)
description:
The light of the lighthouse reaches dozens of miles away.

I wonder if it doesn't startle POKéMON in the sea.

title: Woman 5 (Slateport City)
description: Oh? Your {STR_VAR_1}…

title: Mart Employee (Slateport City)
description:
Welcome!

How may I serve you?

title: Pokefan M (Slateport City)
description: I'm the ENERGY GURU! I'll go for it and sell you what you need!

title: Aqua Member M (Slateport City)
description:
What's the new scheme, I wonder?

Our BOSS is scary when he's mad, so I'd better not screw things up…

title: Aqua Member M (Slateport City)
description: If there's something we need in the MUSEUM, we should take it all!

title: Aqua Member M (Slateport City)
description: Hey, you there! Don't butt in!

title: Aqua Member M (Slateport City)
description:
A long line, huh?

It reminds me of the times I lined up to buy smash-hit games…

title: Aqua Member M (Slateport City)
description: Why are we even lining up and paying? We should just march in!

title: Aqua Member M (Slateport City)
description: What? What do you want?

title: Aqua Member M (Slateport City)
description:
Grumble…

I should've brought my Game Boy Advance so I wouldn't get bored in line…

Grumble…

title: Aqua Member M (Slateport City)
description:
When this operation's over, I'll take you to a hot spring spa!

That's what our leader said. I can't wait!

title: Pokefan F (Slateport City)
description:
If a wild POKéMON gets hurt, it heals itself by chewing on BERRIES.

Did you know that?

Somebody saw that and got the idea of making medicine from BERRIES.

Did you know that?

To turn BERRIES into medicine, they must be crushed into powder.

Did you know that?

You seem to have an interest in BERRIES!

I've got something good for someone like you.

So, like, I couldn't find myself any POKéMON that were, like, for me.

So, I figured, like, hey, I should file a complaint to the guy there?

And he wouldn't hear me out, like, hey! So, like, total bummer, man!

description:
For a ship to sail safely, we need to know about the weather!

Speaking of weather, I heard something from a guy at the WEATHER INSTITUTE.

He was saying abnormal weather has been reported all over the place!

You should visit the WEATHER INSTITUTE and ask around!

If I squeezed in, there wouldn't be any room for the CAPTAIN…

title: Expert M (Verdanturf Town · Battle Tent Lobby)
description:
I welcome you to the BATTLE TENT VERDANTURF SITE!

Here, the TRAINER's trust toward POKéMON is tested.

title: Girl 1 (Verdanturf Town · Battle Tent Lobby)
description:
My feelings toward my POKéMON… The attraction runs deep…

Oh, hi, you didn't see that, did you? Well, it doesn't matter.

How would you like this TM for your POKéMON?

title: Boy 3 (Verdanturf Town · Battle Tent Lobby)
description:
What kind of moves have you taught your POKéMON?

I think you would give yourself an advantage if they knew how to heal or protect themselves.

title: Boy 2 (Verdanturf Town · Battle Tent Lobby)
description:
If it doesn't like a certain move, a POKéMON will be reluctant to use it.

It doesn't matter how strong it is, either.

For example, a POKéMON with a GENTLE nature probably won't enjoy hurting its opponents.

If it can't seem to live up to its potential, it's probably failing at using a disliked move against its will.

title: Scott (Verdanturf Town · Battle Tent Lobby)
description:
SCOTT: Hey there, {PLAYER}{KUN}! I thought I might see you here.

A BATTLE TENT's a place where you can meet tough TRAINERS.

It doesn't matter what the rules are, or how battles are waged, either.

{PLAYER}{KUN}, I expect you to do the best you can!

title: Little Boy (Verdanturf Town · Battle Tent Lobby)
description:
My big sister is gentle usually. But when she gets angry, she's really, really scary!

I bet a gentle POKéMON will be scary if it gets angry!

description:
Far away, deep in EVER GRANDE CITY, is the POKéMON LEAGUE.

The TRAINERS who gather there are all frighteningly well skilled.

description:
In the POKéMON LEAGUE, I think the rules say that you have to battle the ELITE FOUR all in a row.

If you lose to any of them, you have to begin your challenge again from the first one.

It jacks up the power of some moves even though it's only for one battle.

We restore your tired POKéMON to full health.

Would you like to rest your POKéMON?

title: Gentleman (Verdanturf Town · Pokemon Center · 1F)
description:
You can't consider yourself a real TRAINER if you don't have faith in your POKéMON.

Only those people who can believe in their battling POKéMON can win through to the very end.

title: Expert M (Verdanturf Town · Pokemon Center · 1F)
description:
The reason why anyone would visit VERDANTURF…

It's the BATTLE TENT. It goes without saying.

Or is there somebody here that you came to see?

title: Little Boy (Verdanturf Town · Pokemon Center · 1F)
description:
There's a move that gets stronger when you keep using it in a row.

It's a BUG-type move, and it is wickedly cool.

It's called FURY CUTTER. Want me to teach it to a POKéMON?

title: Wally (Verdanturf Town · Wandas House)
description:
WALLY: I lost to you, {PLAYER}, but I'm not feeling down anymore.

Because I have a new purpose in life. Together with my RALTS, I'm going to challenge POKéMON GYMS and become a great TRAINER.

Please watch me, {PLAYER}. I'm going to be stronger than you.

He's been digging a tunnel nonstop just so he can see my daughter.

My daughter's a little concerned, so she goes out to the tunnel a lot.

title: The Player (Brendan / May)
description: The protagonist: Norman's child, who moves to Littleroot Town and sets out to complete the Pokédex and become Champion. Chosen as Brendan or May at the start; the other becomes the rival.
history: Player name/gender are runtime values ({PLAYER}, FLAG gender checks). Sprites have normal, bike, surfing, field-move, fishing, watering, decorating and underwater variants.

title: The Rival (May / Brendan)
description: Prof. Birch's child and the player's neighbour and friendly rival. Battles the player five times (Route 103, Rustboro, Route 110, Route 119, Lilycove), always with the starter strong against the player's.
history: Which character appears depends on the player's gender; trainer variants are keyed by the player's starter.

title: Mom
description: The player's mother. Welcomes the player to Littleroot, gives the Running Shoes and heals the party at home.

title: Norman (Dad)
description: The player's father and Petalburg City Gym Leader (Normal type). Asks the player to help Wally, and is the fifth Gym battle once the player has four badges. Gives the S.S. Ticket after the Hall of Fame.
history: The family moved to Hoenn because Norman became Petalburg's Gym Leader.

title: Rival's Mom
description: Prof. Birch's wife, who welcomes the player next door.

title: Prof. Birch
description: Hoenn's Pokémon Professor, who studies Pokémon habitats in the field. Rescued by the player on Route 101, gives the starter and the Pokédex, rates Pokédex progress via PC and upgrades it to National.
history: Appears in the opening speech (src/main_menu.c / birch speech) and at the Champion's room.

title: Wally
description: A frail boy from Petalburg moving to Verdanturf for his health. The player helps him catch Ralts; he battles the player in Mauville and, recovered and confident, at Victory Road with Gardevoir.
history: Victory Road rematches wally-vr-2..5 are post-game rematches.

title: Wally's Uncle
description: Wally's uncle, who looks after him in Verdanturf and worries about his health.

title: Wally's Father
description: Gives the player HM03 Surf after the Balance Badge, in thanks for helping his son.

title: Wanda
description: Wally's cousin in Verdanturf, whose boyfriend is digging Rusturf Tunnel by hand to reach her.

title: Steven Stone
description: Son of Devon's president and a collector of rare stones. Met in Granite Cave, he gives the Devon Scope, fights beside the player at the Mossdeep Space Center, gives HM08 Dive, and guides the player during the Sootopolis crisis. Battled post-game in Meteor Falls.
history: Lives in Mossdeep; his house later gives the player a Beldum.

title: Mr. Stone
description: President of Devon Corporation and Steven's father. Gives the PokéNav and asks the player to deliver a letter to Steven and the Devon Goods to Capt. Stern; later gives the Exp. Share.

title: Devon Researcher
description: Devon Corp. employee robbed in Petalburg Woods and whose Devon Goods are stolen in Rustboro.

title: Mr. Briney
description: A retired sea captain on Route 104 who sails the player to Dewford and Slateport after the player rescues his Wingull, Peeko. Later seen on the S.S. Tidal.

title: Peeko
description: Mr. Briney's beloved Wingull, kidnapped by Team Aqua in Rusturf Tunnel and rescued by the player.

title: Capt. Stern
description: Slateport ocean researcher building a submarine with Devon parts. Team Aqua steals the submarine from Lilycove; he later hands over the Scanner exchange and shows up on the S.S. Tidal.

title: Prof. Cozmo
description: Fallarbor meteorite researcher whose meteorite is taken by Team Magma at Meteor Falls. Gives TM27 Return when it is returned.

title: Rydel
description: Owner of Rydel's Cycles in Mauville; lends the Mach or Acro Bike and lets the player swap between them.

title: Wattson
description: Mauville Gym Leader (Electric) and the city's redeveloper. Asks the player to shut off the generator in New Mauville (Basement Key, TM24 Thunderbolt).

title: Roxanne
description: Rustboro Gym Leader (Rock), an honour student of the Pokémon Trainer's School.

title: Brawly
description: Dewford Gym Leader (Fighting), a surfer who trains in the waves and caves around Dewford.

title: Flannery
description: Lavaridge Gym Leader (Fire), newly appointed and trying hard to live up to her grandfather.

title: Winona
description: Fortree Gym Leader (Flying), who soars with her bird Pokémon.

title: Tate
description: One of the twin Mossdeep Gym Leaders (Psychic); fights alongside his sister Liza in a double battle.

title: Liza
description: One of the twin Mossdeep Gym Leaders (Psychic); fights alongside her brother Tate.

title: Juan
description: Sootopolis Gym Leader (Water) and Wallace's former mentor, who returns as Leader after Wallace becomes Champion.

title: Sidney
description: Elite Four member (Dark).

title: Phoebe
description: Elite Four member (Ghost) who trained on Mt. Pyre.

title: Glacia
description: Elite Four member (Ice) who came to Hoenn to train.

title: Drake
description: Elite Four member (Dragon), a former sailor and the last of the four.

title: Wallace
description: Hoenn Champion (Water) and former Sootopolis Gym Leader. Guards the Cave of Origin during the crisis, gives HM07 Waterfall, and is the final battle of the main story.

title: Scott
description: A talent scout who keeps turning up to watch the player (Rustboro school, Battle Tents, Ever Grande) and finally invites them to his Battle Frontier.

title: Maxie
description: Leader of Team Magma, who wants to expand the land for people by awakening Groudon. Battled at Mt. Chimney, Magma Hideout and the Mossdeep Space Center.

title: Tabitha
description: Team Magma Admin and Maxie's right hand.

title: Archie
description: Leader of Team Aqua, who wants to expand the sea for Pokémon by awakening Kyogre. First seen at the Oceanic Museum, battled in the Seafloor Cavern.

title: Matt
description: Team Aqua Admin battled in the Aqua Hideout.

title: Shelly
description: Team Aqua Admin battled at the Weather Institute and in the Seafloor Cavern.

title: Mt. Pyre's elderly couple
description: The old couple guarding the Red and Blue Orbs at Mt. Pyre's summit. The woman gives the player the Magma Emblem.

title: Gabby & Ty
description: A TV interviewer and cameraman duo who roam Hoenn's routes and challenge the player to double battles for their show.
history: Their interviews feed the TV system (data/text/tv.inc).

title: Lanette
description: Creator of the Pokémon Storage System PC ('LANETTE's PC').

title: Anabel (Salon Maiden)
description: Frontier Brain of the Battle Tower.

title: Tucker (Dome Ace)
description: Frontier Brain of the Battle Dome.

title: Spenser (Palace Maven)
description: Frontier Brain of the Battle Palace.

title: Greta (Arena Tycoon)
description: Frontier Brain of the Battle Arena.

title: Noland (Factory Head)
description: Frontier Brain of the Battle Factory.

title: Lucy (Pike Queen)
description: Frontier Brain of the Battle Pike.

title: Brandon (Pyramid King)
description: Frontier Brain of the Battle Pyramid.

title: Stone Badge
description: Badge 1 of 8, from Rustboro Gym. Lets Pokémon use Cut outside battle.

title: Knuckle Badge
description: Badge 2 of 8, from Dewford Gym. Lets Pokémon use Flash outside battle; traded Pokémon up to Lv. 30 obey.

title: Dynamo Badge
description: Badge 3 of 8, from Mauville Gym. Lets Pokémon use Rock Smash outside battle.

title: Heat Badge
description: Badge 4 of 8, from Lavaridge Gym. Lets Pokémon use Strength outside battle; traded Pokémon up to Lv. 50 obey.

title: Balance Badge
description: Badge 5 of 8, from Petalburg Gym. Lets Pokémon use Surf outside battle.

title: Feather Badge
description: Badge 6 of 8, from Fortree Gym. Lets Pokémon use Fly outside battle; traded Pokémon up to Lv. 70 obey.

title: Mind Badge
description: Badge 7 of 8, from Mossdeep Gym. Lets Pokémon use Dive outside battle.

title: Rain Badge
description: Badge 8 of 8, from Sootopolis Gym. Lets Pokémon use Waterfall outside battle; all traded Pokémon obey.

title: Team Aqua
description: Villainous team led by Archie that wants to expand the oceans by awakening Kyogre with the Red Orb. Base: Aqua Hideout in Lilycove.

title: Team Magma
description: Villainous team led by Maxie that wants to expand the landmass by awakening Groudon with the Blue Orb. Base: Magma Hideout inside Mt. Chimney.

title: Devon Corporation
description: Rustboro-based manufacturer of Poké Balls, the PokéNav, Devon Scope and submarine parts; run by Mr. Stone.

title: Pokémon League
description: Hoenn's league at Ever Grande City: Elite Four and Champion, reached by Victory Road after eight badges.

title: Rustboro Gym
description: Rock-type Gym, Leader Roxanne. Stone Badge.

title: Dewford Gym
description: Fighting-type Gym (dark maze), Leader Brawly. Knuckle Badge.

title: Mauville Gym
description: Electric-type Gym (switch barriers), Leader Wattson. Dynamo Badge.

title: Lavaridge Gym
description: Fire-type Gym (hot-spring geysers), Leader Flannery. Heat Badge.

title: Petalburg Gym
description: Normal-type Gym (themed rooms), Leader Norman. Balance Badge.

title: Fortree Gym
description: Flying-type Gym (rotating gates), Leader Winona. Feather Badge.

title: Mossdeep Gym
description: Psychic-type Gym (warp tiles, double battle), Leaders Tate & Liza. Mind Badge.

title: Sootopolis Gym
description: Water-type Gym (cracking ice floor), Leader Juan. Rain Badge.

title: Weather Institute
description: Route 119 research centre studying weather and the Pokémon that change it; occupied by Team Aqua; later tracks Kyogre/Groudon.

title: Mossdeep Space Center
description: Rocket launch facility in Mossdeep, targeted by Team Magma for its rocket fuel.

title: Oceanic Museum / Stern's Shipyard
description: Capt. Stern's ocean research institutions in Slateport.

title: Battle Frontier
description: Scott's post-game island of seven battle facilities, each with a Frontier Brain.

title: Pokémon Contests
description: Cool/Beauty/Cute/Smart/Tough contests at Normal, Super, Hyper and Master rank, held in Lilycove's Contest Hall.

title: Trick House
description: Route 110 house of the Trick Master, with eight puzzle mazes unlocked by badges.

title: Pokémon Fan Club
description: Slateport club whose chairman rates Pokémon condition and gives scarves.

title: Pokémon Center
description: Nationwide healing centres with nurse Joy-style nurses, PC and link rooms.

title: Poké Mart
description: Item shops; inventory expands with badges (see mart_inventory.csv).

title: Safari Zone
description: Route 121 park where Pokémon are caught with Safari Balls and Pokéblocks.

title: Pokémon Day Care
description: Route 117 couple who raise Pokémon and find Eggs.

title: Mauville Game Corner
description: Slots and roulette for coins and prizes.

title: Pokémon Trainer's School
description: Rustboro school for young Trainers (Quick Claw gift, Scott's first appearance).

title: The Trick House
description: The Trick Master hides in eight puzzle houses on Route 110; each puzzle unlocks with more badges and rewards an item. Puzzle progress is VAR_TRICK_HOUSE_PUZZLE_n_STATE.

title: New Mauville's generator
description: Wattson gives the Basement Key; the player surfs to New Mauville under Route 110, passes Voltorb disguised as items and turns off the overloaded generator for TM24 Thunderbolt.

title: The Abandoned Ship and the Scanner
description: The wreck of the S.S. Cactus on Route 108 hides locked rooms (Storage Key, Room keys) and Capt. Stern's Scanner, which can be traded at Slateport harbor for a Deep Sea Tooth or Scale.

title: Mirage Tower fossils
description: In the Route 111 desert, Mirage Tower holds the Root Fossil and Claw Fossil; the player can take one (the tower then vanishes) and have Devon revive it as Lileep or Anorith. The other is found post-game in the Desert Underpass.

title: The Regi braille puzzle
description: Braille in the Sealed Chamber tells the player to bring Wailord and Relicanth; the resulting quake opens the Desert Ruins, Island Cave and Ancient Tomb, each solved with a braille instruction (Rock Smash, waiting, Fly).

title: The weather trio
description: Groudon (land, drought) and Kyogre (sea, rain) are awakened by Teams Magma and Aqua with the Blue and Red Orbs; Rayquaza of Sky Pillar calms them. Post-game, the Weather Institute tracks Groudon/Kyogre to Terra/Marine Cave.

title: Latias and Latios
description: After the Hall of Fame a TV report sends Latios or Latias (the opposite of the one shown) roaming Hoenn; the other waits on Southern Island with the Eon Ticket.

title: Mirage Island
description: An island off Route 130 that only appears when a party Pokémon's personality matches the day's random value; Wynaut and a Liechi Berry live there.

title: Invisible Kecleon
description: Invisible Kecleon block Fortree's exit and Route 120 bridges; Steven's Devon Scope reveals them.

title: Shoal Cave and the Shell Bell
description: Collect four Shoal Salt and four Shoal Shells at low tide and bring them to the old man in Shoal Cave to receive a Shell Bell.

title: Pokémon Contests
description: Contests in Lilycove's Contest Hall judge Cool, Beauty, Cute, Smart and Tough appeal at four ranks. Winning Master rank paints the Pokémon for the Lilycove Museum. Pokéblocks raise condition.

title: Secret Bases
description: TM43 Secret Power opens hideouts in trees, bushes and cave walls across Hoenn, which the player furnishes with decorations; bases are shared by record mixing.

title: Berry farming
description: Berries are planted in soft soil and watered with the Wailmer Pail; the Berry Master on Route 123 and his wife give berries daily; Pokéblocks are blended from them.

title: Fan clubs and scarves
description: The Slateport Fan Club chairman gives scarves to Pokémon with high condition; Lilycove's Trainer Fan Club follows the player's reputation.

title: TV, news and Gabby & Ty
description: Hoenn TV broadcasts shows built from the player's actions (data/text/tv.inc): interviews by Gabby & Ty, Pokémon News, trend reports from Dewford Hall.

title: The Mauville old men
description: A rotating NPC in Mauville (bard, hipster, trader, storyteller, giddy) whose songs, phrases and stories are built from the player's easy-chat words and records.

title: The Lilycove lady
description: A rotating NPC in the Lilycove Pokémon Center: favor lady, quiz lady or contest lady, each giving items for easy-chat answers or Pokéblocks.

title: Frontier Symbols
description: Each Frontier Brain awards a Silver then Gold Symbol on the Frontier Pass; collecting all lets Scott give the Silver and Gold Shields.

title: Event islands
description: Mystery Gift tickets open Southern Island, Faraway Island (Mew), Navel Rock (Lugia, Ho-Oh) and Birth Island (Deoxys triangle puzzle).

title: Steven's gift
description: After the Hall of Fame Steven's house in Mossdeep holds a Beldum and a letter.

title: The Winstrate family
description: A family of four on Route 111 battles the player in sequence and gives a Macho Brace.

title: Breeding at the Day Care
description: The Route 117 Day Care couple raise two Pokémon and find Eggs when they are compatible (egg groups in species.egg_groups, moves in species_learnsets method=egg).
